rv.q: Marconi has delivered a performance of staggering emotional magnitude—one so fearless, so physically exhilarating, and so spiritually devastating that it lingers long after the lights have faded.
This was one of those performances that will stay with you.

cn.t: Daniel Marconi delivers a spellbinding, soul-baring performance as Thomas Magill in Enda Walsh's "Misterman," with critics praising his complete transformation into the mentally unstable would-be savior of a small Irish town.
